name: CopyDNA
author: CopyDNA

sections.description:
CopyDNA writes text that persuades, in the voice of your business. Connect your site once, pick a brand profile, and write:

  • Blog posts and pages from the block editor sidebar, with an SEO title, meta description and slug. Every text is inserted into the editor as a draft: nothing is published without you.
  • Classic editor too (Classic Editor or Advanced Editor Tools): a “Write with CopyDNA” button next to “Add Media” opens the writer in a popup, and the same writer sits in a box beside the editor.
  • WooCommerce product descriptions, short and long, from the product edit screen.
  • Many product descriptions at once from the products list (paid plans). The previous descriptions are kept and can be restored with one click.
  • Up to 2 free changes per text: shorter, longer, another version, or your own request.

The plugin works in Hebrew, English, Arabic, Russian, Spanish, French and Portuguese (Brazil), and follows the language of your WordPress admin.

External service

This plugin is a client of the CopyDNA service at https://copydna.app. The writing itself happens on CopyDNA servers. When you write a text, the plugin sends CopyDNA the brief you typed (or, for products, the product name, price, categories, attributes and current description) and the language of your admin screen. When you connect, it sends the site address and name. Nothing is sent before you connect the site and click a write button.

  • Terms of service: https://copydna.app/en/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://copydna.app/en/privacy

A CopyDNA account is required. New accounts start with a free trial, no credit card needed.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to CopyDNA in the admin menu and click “Connect to CopyDNA”.
  3. Sign in or create an account, choose a brand profile and approve the connection.
sections.faq:
Is anything published automatically?

No. Posts and pages are inserted into the editor, and products are filled in their description fields. You review, then save or publish.

Does it work with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

Yes. The SEO title and meta description are saved into Yoast SEO or Rank Math when one of them is active. Without an SEO plugin, CopyDNA adds them to that post only.

What does a text cost?

A post or a page uses 1 text from your plan. Product descriptions use a separate monthly product allowance first (short + long = 1 product, a short description alone = half a product); when it runs out, they use texts (a short description = half a text, a long one = 1 text). See https://copydna.app/en/pricing.

  • Security: each user can follow and continue only the texts they started.

1.0.3

  • A short explanation of what a brand profile is: a ? button next to “Brand profile” on the settings screen.

1.0.2

  • Works on PHP 7.0 and later (was 7.4).

1.0.1

  • Works on WordPress 5.3 and later (was 6.5), with all 7 languages also on older WordPress versions.

1.0.0

  • First release.
